rows.reasoning: Koch appears in the Yea list on Senate Roll Call 58, the concurrence vote on SB 1(ss) (2022 First Special Session), whose enrolled operative section makes abortion "a criminal act, except when performed under the following circumstances:" - a serious health risk to the pregnant woman or saving her life, a lethal fetal anomaly, and, during the first ten weeks of postfertilization age, where "the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest". Those exceptions match the rung "ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life.", and the bill's own exceptions exclude "ban abortion in all cases, with no exceptions." while its criminalization of all other abortions excludes "allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health."
